description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to promote food and nutrition security and food systems resilience in Rwanda. This will be achieved through increased sustainable food production from socially and environmentally inclusive agricultural value chains in the three project districts of Ruhango, Nyanza and Gicumbi.

The following outputs will contribute to the achievement of the above objectives;

OP1.1: The capacities of households on nutrition-sensitive agricultural value chains and sustainable agricultural practices are enhanced,

OP 1.2: Households and smallholder farmers have increased access to food commodity markets,

OP 1.3: Households and smallholder farmers have increased access to diversified sustainable productive inputs and tools.

description.narrative: Sustainable food production from socially and environmentally inclusive agricultural value chains is increased in Gicumbi, Ruhango and Nyanza districts.

The indicator measures the average quantity of crop output harvested in Ruhango, Nyanza and Gicumbi per unit area of land (one hectare), separated by different types of crops. This indicator is used to evaluate the productivity of agricultural land for various crops. The baseline data was based on information from the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR), while the targets were guided by the 6% annual growth projection for Rwandas agriculture sector under NST 2..
